# P27.4 — Spine-backed national export bundle (LAUNCH.4)

## Summary

Makes `sig-exports build` emit the **real, national** export from the shaped spine (P27.3),
replacing the hardcoded okc/france fixture requests — every artifact the ten public surfaces
consume, to the frozen P27.1 contracts, so the static site is the real graph "by construction"
(§38.1, SIG-EXPORT-012/013). The new path is additive behind `--from-spine`/`--dsn`; the fixture
`--jurisdiction okc|france` path is byte-for-byte unchanged and stays the CI/demo default.

Read-only throughout: `run_spine_export` opens **one** `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot that
covers shaping AND the supplementary reads, so every emitted artifact describes one spine state,
and no statement can mutate the append-only spine (§16).

Implements `docs/tickets/P27.4__spine-backed-export-bundle.md`
(`implement-spec spec=… live_verification=true`). Stacked on **P27.3**
(`devin/p27-3-export-data-shaping`, PR #114).

## What changed

- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** (new) — the orchestration module:
  - `EXPORT_QUERIES` — compat-guarded (`to_regclass`) supplementary read-only SELECTs:
    source_registry names, entity_identifier labels, research_task rows, publishable
    evidence_artifact metadata, correction claims (`revises_claim`/`retraction_of`). A missing
    table is honest absence (an empty surface), never an error.
  - `build_spine_export(dataset, raw, …)` — the **pure** assembler (unit-tested, no DB):
    licence-slices every site **per `(source, rights_id)`** pair, each slice's observation
    envelope recomputed from *that source's own* observations (`shape_sites` over the per-source
    claim subset — never a silent cross-source merge); `export_refusal_reason` drops a refused
    record (`UNDETERMINED` / non-redistributable / derivative-forbidden / recorded-exclusion)
    **loudly** into the exclusions report; builds per-compartment geo `ExportTable`s + the
    SIG-derived CC-BY framing tables and runs them through `build_bundle` (which computes the
    licence, `assert_separated`, and per-row rights provenance); emits the ten P27.1-contract
    `web/*.json` surfaces, per-compartment PMTiles, a PROV-O lineage, and an extended manifest
    (bundle + web + provenance + exclusions, each with checksum + compartment + licence).
  - `run_spine_export(conn, …)` — opens `default_transaction_read_only` +
    `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY`, runs `run_shaping`'s fetch inside it, fetches the supplementary
    sets in the SAME snapshot, assembles the export.
- **`exports/src/exports/cli.py`** — `sig-exports build --from-spine --dsn --as-of --belief
  --note`, mutually exclusive with `request_json`/`--jurisdiction`, `--dsn` required iff
  `--from-spine`; `_run_build_from_spine` writes the compartmented bundle + `web/*` +
  per-compartment `web/tiles/<compartment>-sites.pmtiles` (ODbL attribution on the OSM layer) +
  `provenance.ttl` + `exclusions.json`. Password via `PGPASSWORD`, never in the DSN (HG-09).
- **`exports/src/exports/shaping.py`** — `_site_licence_conflict` now also swallows
  `ExportGateClosed`: a refused record is a publishability decision the export gate makes per
  `(source, rights)` at build time (`partition_exportable`), not a licence-mix conflict, so a
  publishable-but-export-refused claim no longer crashes site shaping.
- **Spec fold-back (D-P27-SPEC-1, ADR-090 export share)** — `SIG-EXPORT-013` (§38: the
  national/whole-graph spine-read export bundle, breadth bounded by the fail-closed licence gate)
  minted in `spec_src/80_partVII_s37to38_api.md`; spec regenerated via `BUILD.sh` (byte-identical);
  `check_spec_src.py` FOLD_BACK_IDS + `check_coverage_matrix.py` EXPECTED_ROWS bumped to **674**;
  a `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` row added. The §39–41 SIG-UI id + ADR-091/093 shares remain with
  P27.6/P27.9.
- **Tests** — `tests/exports/test_spine_export.py` (21 pure) +
  `tests/db/test_spine_export_over_seeded_spine.py` (2 Docker-gated seeded-spine).

## Design decisions

- **Sites carry per-source rights; the derived aggregate framings are SIG CC-BY.** Only the
  licence-bearing geometry (sites) is sliced per `(source, rights_id)` and placed in the
  compartment its own SPDX declares (ODbL → `osm_physical`, CC-BY → `sig_graph`, …). The
  jurisdiction/coverage/freshness/network/dossier framings are SIG's own analytical expression
  under the CC-BY `sig` record → `sig_graph`. This keeps the ODbL/CC-BY separation clean and the
  underlying claims' rights honoured (the publishable filter + per-site slicing).
- **`SIG-EXPORT-013` vs `SIG-EXPORT-012`.** P27.3 minted SIG-EXPORT-012 (spine-read, shaped at
  build). SIG-EXPORT-013 captures P27.4's distinct contribution: the export is the *national,
  whole-graph* bundle whose *breadth is bounded by the fail-closed licence gate* — squarely the
  §38 export share of ADR-090.
- **`provenance.ttl` as canonical N-Triples.** Serialised via `export_lineage(fmt="nt")` (sorted,
  byte-stable — a valid Turtle subset) so the bundle stays byte-reproducible (SIG-EXPORT-003).

## Live verification (DEFERRED — D-P27.4-1, OPEN)

The live `sig-exports build --from-spine` over hosted `sig-pg` needs cloud-sql-proxy +
credentials + network egress (none in this isolated context), and the OSM land is still in flight
(cross-ref D-P27.1-1) → any live bundle's as-of is PROVISIONAL. Recorded as `D-P27.4-1` with the
exact re-run command; **no live green fabricated**. The deterministic + Docker seeded-spine
evidence is what proves the build.
